name: oneclient-pipeline
description: Build test scenarios like a CI/CD job: run scripts, start test containers, seed data, call REST APIs and assert on the results — step by step, with teardown.

items: Scripts: PowerShell, pwsh, bash, sh or cmd
Test containers through the Docker plugin, with their ports as variables
HTTP requests with status, header, JSON and timing assertions
Commands of other plugins, to seed data
Wait, set variables and check values
Variables and secrets; each step's outputs feed the next
Teardown steps that run even after a failure or a stop
Containers a run started are removed when it ends
Run history and live output, also in the Tasks panel
